verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a library of 760+ integration pieces (connectors) and AI chat-driven flow generation. Neither is a public library of ready-made workflow templates to start from, and no evidence item mentions templates. A template gallery is a fair axis for a workflow automation product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
